magpietts.runtime_note: Current NeMo-Speech.cpp documentation explicitly demonstrates MagpieTTS v2602 plus NanoCodec; it does not establish a native Qwen3-TTS path.

research_delta: The Qwen 0.6B-versus-1.7B experiment must remain a same-family quality/resource A/B and must not be used to infer a native-runtime advantage over MagpieTTS.

Qwen and Magpie currently differ in both model family and runtime substrate in the pinned source plan. Comparing them without an attribution fence would confound model quality with Python/CUDA/native-C++ runtime overhead.

The official source artifact sizes create a useful pre-runtime storage/headroom signal: the 1.7B Qwen checkpoint is materially larger than the 0.6B checkpoint, but no RAM/VRAM/latency conclusion is credited until clay-direct-dev measurement.

MagpieTTS v2607 is the newer quality checkpoint while the current documented NeMo-Speech.cpp native conversion path pins v2602. These must stay separate benchmark cells rather than being treated as the same artifact/runtime identity.
